baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction kāffatan li-l-nās, reinforced by the second occurrence of al-nās.
baseline_models.mechanism: A carried message is dispatched into the human collective as an encompassing whole; its hopeful and alarming faces address the same unrestricted audience, while the majority clause marks failed uptake inside that total scope.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message branch supplies the carried communication and makes dispatch the mechanism's initiating act.
Encompassing everyone supplies the mission's unrestricted human perimeter.
The visible human collective supplies both the audience and the majority located within it.
Joy-opening news supplies the attractive face of the communication.
Danger-announcement that awakens caution supplies the communication's protective face.
Numerical predominance locates non-recognition in most, without narrowing the all-human address.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the uptake that the majority clause negates.

changed_reading.before: The verse appoints a messenger for a large audience.
changed_reading.after: The verse establishes an all-human communication perimeter and then diagnoses majority non-recognition inside, not outside, that perimeter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated role nouns bashīran wa-nadhīran followed by lā yaʿlamūn.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger carries two anticipatory signals: one opens the surface toward a hoped-for arrival and one sounds danger early enough to activate caution. Together they make otherwise future consequences knowable in advance.

activation_trace.role: The carried-message branch supplies the vehicle by which both signals travel.
First traces appearing before completion make good news an advance indicator rather than only a pleasant report.
An alarm that awakens caution supplies the adverse advance indicator.
A distinguishing mark that guides toward its referent makes the paired reports signs to be read.

changed_reading.before: Bashīr and nadhīr are two descriptive titles.
changed_reading.after: They are a paired advance-signal system intended to turn an unseen future into actionable present knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tension between arsalnāka, which releases or dispatches, and the k-f-f form kāffatan.
baseline_models.mechanism: A messenger is released into the human field to check movement toward harm: warning supplies the stop-signal, while good news supplies a positive direction rather than mere inhibition.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch supply the outward movement of the intervention.
Checking, preventing, and turning back supply the intervention's restraining function.
Warning activates caution and operationalizes restraint before danger.
Joy-opening news prevents the model from reducing the mission to prohibition alone.

changed_reading.before: Kāffatan states only how many people are addressed.
changed_reading.after: It may also color what the dispatched messenger does: restrain people from danger through a warning paired with an opening toward good.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Bashīran and lā yaʿlamūn within an address to al-nās.
baseline_models.mechanism: The message gives concealed outcomes a publicly perceptible surface and distinguishing marks. The majority's deficit is therefore not simply missing data but failure to register what has been made socially and sensorially available.

activation_trace.role: The carried saying supplies the content placed in public circulation.
Seeing, sensing, or hearing supplies the audience's available mode of recognition.
The exposed skin or surface supplies a material analogy for truth becoming outwardly legible.
A visible distinguishing mark supplies the bridge from displayed sign to knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Most people merely lack abstract information.
changed_reading.after: A public signal has been surfaced for them, yet most fail to convert perception of its marks into recognition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Kāffatan through the packet's secondary k-f-y mapping, in construction with li-l-nās.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split-root inventory permits kāffatan to activate adequacy: the dispatched communication stands up to the whole human need by supplying both promise and warning. This is form-distant and coexists with the direct k-f-f totality and restraint readings.

activation_trace.role: Carrying an affair until sufficiency is reached supplies the exploratory adequacy mechanism.
The carried message is the thing proposed as adequate for the addressed need.
The human collective defines the breadth of the need for which adequacy is proposed.
Good news supplies one necessary side of a complete communication.
Warning supplies the complementary protective side of that communication.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the mission is also adequate to the human condition because it carries both needed orientations, promise and warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context fills space with inward, outward, downward, and upward movement, then spans from the smallest to the largest. These axes thicken kāffatan from a population count into coverage with no privileged direction or scale.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing all supplies the focus anchor whose geometry is expanded by the context.
Entry into an interior supplies inward traversal of the covered field.
Passing outward supplies the inverse traversal and closes the in-out axis.
Descent and arrival supply downward movement through the field.
Ascent supplies the opposing upward movement.
Smallness supplies one endpoint of a scale that excludes no minute case.
Magnitude supplies the opposite endpoint and completes the scale.

structural_cues: 34:2 repeats four matched relative clauses for what enters, exits, descends, and ascends.
34:3 encloses smaller and larger items within the paired heavens-and-earth frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive directional and scalar pairs; I project their coverage geometry onto kāffatan. A live alternative is that these pairs describe divine knowledge only and do not specify the messenger's reach.

changed_reading.before: All people means an undifferentiated numerical total.
changed_reading.after: The all-human scope is imagined as coverage across moving interiors and exteriors, vertical directions, and scalar extremes.

context_deltas.mechanism: A chain of visible settlements and measured travel turns universal dispatch into a relay across inhabited nodes. The next ayah's requested distance and resulting fragmentation show what the relay must cross and repair: human totality is distributed, route-dependent, and liable to rupture.

activation_trace.role: Successive companies supply a relay image for dispatch reaching distributed groups.
All-encompassing scope requires the relay to include every inhabited node.
People gathered in settlements supply the human nodes of the relay.
Prominent visibility makes the intermediate nodes publicly findable.
Measured planning supplies ordered intervals rather than accidental contact.
Travel and flow activate movement along the linked settlement chain.
Producing distance supplies the deliberate rupture of accessible intervals.
Tearing into scattered pieces supplies the social geography the universal message must span.

structural_cues: 34:18 sequences visible settlements, measured travel, nights, days, and safety.
34:19 reverses that accessibility into requested distance, self-wrong, stories, and complete dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a connected route and its rupture; I infer that successive dispatch is a communicative relay across dispersed communities. The route may instead function only as a material history of provision and ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: A single center broadcasts one message to a global mass.
changed_reading.after: Universal sending works as a relay through inhabited nodes, retaining scope even when communities become distant and fragmented.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly places beneficial and harmful outcomes in parallel response tracks. This converts the two focus roles from tonal labels into a causal fork: the message announces what distinct patterns of reception grow into.

activation_trace.role: Joy-opening news names the beneficial arm of the fork.
Danger-announcement names the harmful arm early enough for caution.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the causal linkage between response and outcome.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer supplies one concrete good announced.
An apportioned gift supplies the positive consequence paired with protection.
Painful punishment supplies the concrete adverse consequence of the warning track.
Increase by a matching multiple intensifies the beneficial consequence in the later reprise.
The repeated punishment branch restores the adverse track immediately after the intensified reward.

structural_cues: 34:4-5 juxtaposes believers who act well with those who strive against the signs.
34:37-38 repeats the same beneficial-versus-punitive sequencing after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored recipient groups and outcomes; I assign the arrow from the focus's two heralding roles to those consequence tracks. The live alternative is that bashīr and nadhīr remain general titles without encoding this exact local pairing.

changed_reading.before: The messenger alternates reassurance and threat.
changed_reading.after: He announces a response-sensitive consequence fork, making both possible trajectories knowable before they mature.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge in the surah repeatedly arises when a visible disclosure is correctly matched to reality, while failure persists before clear signs and even after demonstrations. The focus's majority clause therefore diagnoses failed recognition of available evidence, not simple absence of exposure.

activation_trace.role: Advance traces supply signs that should permit recognition before completion.
A mark that distinguishes and guides supplies the focus's evidentiary model of knowing.
Vision by eye or insight supplies the act by which informed recipients recognize revelation.
Knowledge as disclosure identifies the recipients capable of the recognition.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what correct seeing recognizes.
Emergence into clarity supplies the collapse-triggered disclosure of prior ignorance.
The counterfactual knowing of the unseen marks the knowledge disproved by visible events.
The repeated numerical majority ties the focus diagnosis to a second concrete domain.
The repeated human audience confirms that the same collective remains under diagnosis.
The exact repeated non-knowing clause applies failed recognition to provision's expansion and restriction.
Meaning made clear by signs and speech supplies evidence that is present yet reclassified as deception.

structural_cues: 34:6 joins people given knowledge, seeing, revelation, and truth in one recognition chain.
34:14 makes a collapse reveal that the workers had not known the unseen.
34:36 repeats most people do not know almost verbatim.
34:43 answers clear recited signs with inherited resistance and accusations of fabrication and magic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, correct recognition, demonstrable ignorance, an exact refrain, and rejection of clarity; I infer that the focus names a recognition failure. A live alternative is a narrower lack of doctrinal knowledge rather than resistant misclassification.

changed_reading.before: Most people have not received enough information.
changed_reading.after: Most people fail to let publicly available marks disclose what they indicate, even though universal sending has already supplied exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes coercive power from channels of following, diversion, and repeated command. Against that social machinery, the k-f-f restraint activation becomes counter-interception: the messenger checks inherited or organized movement away from guidance without wielding compulsion.

activation_trace.role: Prevention and turning back supply the focus's counter-diversion function.
Warning activates caution rather than force and defines how the checking works.
Following in another's wake supplies the social current that carries most recipients.
Overpowering force is explicitly named and denied, constraining restraint to non-coercive intervention.
Turning and diverting supply the disputed blockage between guidance and socially weaker recipients.
Demand and imposition supply the repeated directive pressure attributed to dominant recipients.
The accusation that the messenger diverts people from ancestral worship mirrors and reverses the blockage claim.

structural_cues: 34:20-21 places widespread following beside the denial of coercive authority.
34:31-33 stages reciprocal blame between the socially weakened and the self-exalting.
34:43 frames the messenger himself as an alleged diverter from inherited worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following without coercive authority and rival claims about who diverted whom; I infer that k-f-f restraint intercepts those channels through warning. The direct alternative remains that kāffatan means only all people and carries no restraining predication.

changed_reading.before: The messenger restrains isolated individuals from discrete bad acts.
changed_reading.after: The mission checks socially transmitted diversion, creating room for recognition without replacing one coercive authority with another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same dispatch root releases both a human messenger and, elsewhere, a dam-flood, while later ayat repeatedly bind sending to warning. The shared mechanism is not identity of messenger and flood but release into a field where the dispatched thing has effects.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch supply the focus's outward operative movement.
Warning defines the messenger's effect as awakened caution before danger arrives.
The repeated release verb supplies a material counter-instance of dispatch producing consequences.
Flood-flow supplies the force actually released in the contextual instance.
A retaining dam supplies the boundary whose failure turns held force into released flow.
Repeated messenger dispatch joins sender, warning-bearer, and resistant recipients in one transmission event.
The warning role is explicitly attached to the repeated dispatch pattern.
The claimed absence of an earlier dispatch marks the present sending as a new effective arrival.
The absent prior figure is specifically a danger-announcer, confirming dispatch's preventive aim.

structural_cues: 34:16 uses the focus's dispatch root for the flood released after turning away.
34:34 repeats sending and warning in a generalized town pattern.
34:44 stresses that no warning-bearer had previously been sent to these recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence across messenger and flood plus repeated sent-warner constructions; I infer a shared release-to-effect dynamic. The live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no material analogy between the dispatched entities.

changed_reading.before: Sending is an administrative appointment that precedes speech.
changed_reading.after: Sending releases an effective signal into history: unlike the flood, its immediate force is to make caution possible before consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The all-human audience is operationally decomposed into pairs and solitary persons who stand and think. Universality therefore does not require mass conformity; the same warning reaches everyone through deliberative units small enough to interrupt group pressure.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing everyone supplies the aggregate that the context decomposes.
The human collective supplies the social scale from which pairs and individuals are drawn.
Fear-awakening reminder supplies the focused intervention delivered to the decomposed audience.
One in number supplies the single proposition around which deliberation is organized.
Rising with resolve supplies the audience's active break from passive crowd membership.
Joining one to one supplies the paired deliberative unit.
The isolated one supplies the irreducible individual unit.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies the process by which each unit tests the message.
The repeated warning role reconnects this small-unit exercise directly to the focus mission.

structural_cues: 34:46 moves in sequence from one exhortation to standing, pairs, solitary persons, reflection, the familiar companion, and warning.
The pair-and-individual instruction comes after prolonged scenes of followers, leaders, and inherited claims.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal scope and an explicit pair-or-single reflection procedure; I infer that the latter is how the former reaches persons without crowd mediation. A live alternative is that 34:46 offers only a local method for evaluating the messenger.

changed_reading.before: All humanity is addressed chiefly as one mass audience.
changed_reading.after: Universal scope preserves individual agency by reaching the mass through pairs and solitary reflection rather than requiring collective uptake.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed appointment, warning positioned before punishment, and the closing sequence from nearness to failed far-reaching and final barrier turn the paired heralding roles into a temporal access window. The message reaches people now because later recognition can arrive after reach has become impossible.

activation_trace.role: First traces of what is coming supply the early side of the access window.
Advance danger-notice supplies the warning while response remains possible.
An appointment bounded by time supplies the fixed terminus of the window.
Advance and precedence, here negated, prevent recipients from moving the terminus forward.
The repeated warning makes caution the intended use of the still-open interval.
Placement before one's hands spatializes the messenger on the near side of punishment.
Failure to escape or attain supplies the first explicit closure of reach.
Nearness makes capture immediate despite the earlier illusion of distance.
Extending to take hold supplies the late attempt at retrieval.
Distance defeats that late reach and contrasts with the message's earlier proximity.
A separating barrier supplies the terminal state in which desired response can no longer cross.

structural_cues: 34:29-30 asks when the promise comes and answers with an appointment that cannot be delayed or advanced.
34:46 places the warner before a severe punishment.
34:51-54 progresses through no escape, seizure from near, impossible reach from far, and a final barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed timing and a staged loss of reach; I infer that the focus's heralding functions create a present response interval. The live alternative is that the closing sequence concerns only punishment after disbelief and does not define the earlier mission's temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Good news and warning report an unspecified future.
changed_reading.after: They make the present a reachable decision interval before a fixed future closes the distance between recognition and effective response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing declarations model transmission as hidden knowledge cast outward, truth arriving, falsehood losing productive motion, and revelation becoming hearable at close range. The focus messenger is thus a vector that converts concealed knowledge into public, discriminating signal.

activation_trace.role: The carried communication supplies the human transmission vehicle.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the intended endpoint of transmission.
Casting outward supplies the forceful launch of truth into the public field.
Reality-stable truth supplies the content launched.
Initiating motion, here denied to falsehood, supplies one side of the transmission asymmetry.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the signal that cannot sustain productive transmission.
Neither initiating nor repeating supplies falsehood's silenced return channel.
Knowledge delivered in concealment supplies the hidden origin of the messenger's guidance.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the receiver-side completion of the channel.
Nearness shortens the channel and removes distance as an excuse for failed reception.

structural_cues: 34:48 moves from spoken command to casting truth by one who knows hidden things.
34:49 announces truth's arrival and denies falsehood both initiation and repetition.
34:50 locates guidance in revelation and closes with hearing and nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies launch, arrival, productive asymmetry, hidden revelation, hearing, and nearness; I connect them into a transmission path fulfilled by the focus messenger. They may instead be adjacent assertions without a single communication mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The messenger repeats information already available in propositional form.
changed_reading.after: He is the public leg of a hidden-to-near transmission vector that launches truth into human hearing and distinguishes it from nonproductive falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split k-f-y adequacy activation gains force when claimed powers are stripped of ownership, partnership, independent intercession, benefit, and harm. The all-human message appears sufficient not by monopolizing force but by remaining a viable guidance channel when imagined supports fail.

activation_trace.role: Carrying an affair to sufficiency supplies the exploratory focus mechanism.
Ownership and capacity to dispose, here denied, remove one proposed rival support.
A helper joining another, here made permission-dependent, removes autonomous mediation.
Benefit opposed to harm, here denied to intercession by itself, tests practical adequacy.
Denied mutual control shows the eventual collapse of person-to-person possession of outcomes.
Denied mutual benefit strips one final substitute for receiving the warning.
Denied mutual harm completes the context's removal of independent human outcome-control.

structural_cues: 34:22 denies invoked powers any atom of ownership, share, or supporting role.
34:23 makes intercession effective only by permission.
34:42 denies people mutual control of benefit and harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the secondary k-f-y inventory and progressive removal of rival agencies; I infer that the message's twofold orientation is adequate when those supports collapse. The live and stronger alternatives derive kāffatan directly from k-f-f as all-encompassing or restraining.

changed_reading.before: The split-root sufficiency image is an isolated lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a coherent, though still form-distant, reading in which the universal mission remains an adequate guidance channel after rival supports prove unable to own outcomes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the materially distant k-f-f image of a containing scale-pan. It remains anchored in kāffatan and is strengthened by contextual gathering and adjudication of all; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial-material analogy, not as a grammatical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Kāffatan at word 4, especially the containing-pan and all-encompassing branches.

activation_trace.role: A pan or containing vessel supplies the outlier's bounded common field.
Encompassing everyone places the whole human audience within that field.
Drawing dispersed parties into one aggregate supplies the common gathering.
Opening what is closed by judgment supplies adjudication within the gathered field.
Driving and gathering a multitude toward one destination gives the analogy its eschatological horizon.
Completion without dispersion or deficit supplies the all-together state.

changed_reading.before: Kāffatan only expands the present audience outward.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also anticipates humanity enclosed within one common field of gathering and truthful adjudication.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the sociable familiarity branches of n-w-s and r-s-l rather than the dominant population and dispatch senses. It remains anchored in the repeated al-nās and arsalnāka, while the messenger is later called their companion and hearing is paired with nearness; downstream prose should qualify it as a relational activation, not a claim that universal scope literally means intimacy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Arsalnāka and both occurrences of al-nās, read through familiarity rather than anonymous mass.

activation_trace.role: Ease, familiarity, and unguarded presence supply a relational mode for the dispatch.
Companionship that removes estrangement recasts the human collective as potentially familiar rather than anonymous.
Explicit companionship and sustained association place the warning-bearer within the audience's known social field.
Audible reception supplies immediate interpersonal access to the message.
Nearness supplies the relation that can overcome estrangement even within an all-human address.

changed_reading.before: Universality requires impersonal broadcast to anonymous humanity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the all-human mission scales through familiar presence: a known companion makes a near, hearable address without surrendering universal scope.

strongest_changes: Kāffatan became multidimensional coverage across direction, scale, settlement networks, and dispersed communities rather than a bare population total.
Bashīr and nadhīr became paired advance signals tied to mirrored consequence tracks and to a response window that eventually closes.
Most people do not know became a diagnosis of failed sign-recognition despite public exposure, not merely missing information.
The restraint branch became socially functional: warning intercepts following and diversion without coercive authority.
The all-human collective was decomposed into pairs and solitary persons, preserving reflective agency within universal scope.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly translated the focus's compact universal claim into mechanisms of movement, relay, social pressure, visible disclosure, fixed timing, and eventual gathering while keeping several incompatible k-f-f branches alive.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether kāffatan syntactically supports an active restraining role or only all-encompassing scope remains unresolved.
The k-f-y sufficiency model is packet-licensed but form-distant and should remain subordinate to direct k-f-f readings.
The motion, flood-dispatch, and gathering-pan models may be productive analogies without being intended lexical specifications of 34:28.
Failed knowing can still be parsed as cognitive deficit, resistant misclassification, or both.
